description: Supervisor verifies origin-synced on every pass instead of trusting the worker's push claim; emits a structured push event for audit.

userStories.title: Supervisor verifies origin-synced on every pass (deterministic backstop)
userStories.description: As the cam supervisor, I need to verify that a worker's pass actually landed on origin (HEAD == origin/<branch>) before I continue the loop, so an unpushed worker claim cannot silently mark a story complete on local-only commits.
acceptanceCriteria: src/supervisor/loop.ts adds an optional injected ensurePushed?: () => { ok: boolean; pushed: boolean; sha: string; detail: string } to RunSupervisorOptions.
In the pass branch of runSupervisor (after writeSessionMarker, before the iteration's continue), when ensurePushed is provided, the supervisor calls it.

When ensurePushed returns ok:false, the supervisor degrades lastOutcome to { kind: 'blocked', storyId, detail } with a clear push-failure detail derived from the ensurePushed result and returns { status: 'blocked', iterations, lastOutcome } instead of continuing the loop.
When ensurePushed returns ok:true, the supervisor continues the loop unchanged (no behavior delta vs. today's pass branch).
When ensurePushed is absent (undefined), the pass branch is byte-for-byte unchanged: no-op, backward compatible, existing loop tests still pass without modification.
Both the exit-mode pass branch AND the sentinel-mode pass branch (where writeSessionMarker is also called) verify push via ensurePushed; behavior is identical across both.

src/commands/next.ts wires a real ensurePushed adapter: idempotent `git push origin <branch>` (uses the same `git branch --show-current` pattern as finalizeStory; treats Everything-up-to-date as success), then verifies `git rev-parse HEAD === git rev-parse origin/<branch>` and returns { ok, pushed, sha, detail }; pushed:false means the local sha already matched origin (no-op push), pushed:true means the push moved origin.

ensurePushed in next.ts uses spawnSync (encoding utf8) consistent with the existing supervisorSpawn/finalizeStory pattern; non-zero exit on push OR mismatched HEAD vs origin/<branch> yields ok:false with the captured stderr/stdout in detail.

test/supervisor/loop.test.ts covers: (a) pass-but-unpushed -> ensurePushed runs, pushes, returns ok:true pushed:true, loop continues; (b) pass-already-synced -> ensurePushed returns ok:true pushed:false, loop continues with no extra side effects; (c) ensurePushed ok:false -> supervisor returns status:'blocked' with the push-failure detail surfaced on lastOutcome; (d) ensurePushed absent -> existing pass-branch behavior unchanged.
All loop tests use injected fakes for ensurePushed (no real git invocations).
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck)
Tests pass (bun test)
userStories.notes: Files to touch: src/supervisor/loop.ts (add ensurePushed to RunSupervisorOptions, call it in both pass branches after writeSessionMarker), src/commands/next.ts (wire real ensurePushed adapter, pass through to runSupervisor), test/supervisor/loop.test.ts (4 new cases with fake ensurePushed). Reuse the spawnSync + `git branch --show-current` pattern already in finalizeStory in next.ts (around line 545-551). 'pass' branch in loop.ts lives at two sites: exit mode around line 743-746 (writeSessionMarker on outcome.kind==='pass') and sentinel mode around line 558-560 (same call). Both must call ensurePushed AFTER writeSessionMarker and BEFORE the `continue`. Treat 'Everything up-to-date' from `git push` as ok:true pushed:false. Gotchas: noUncheckedIndexedAccess (guard match[N] when parsing stdout); supervisorSpawn returns { stdout, exitCode } so detail must concatenate stderr separately (use spawnSync directly in next.ts adapter, not the supervisorSpawn wrapper which drops stderr). Conventional commit. Do not add any --permission-mode flag (project rule).

userStories.title: Structured push-verification event for audit
userStories.description: As an operator diagnosing a cam-cli run, I need a structured event in .claude/cam-worker-events.jsonl every time the supervisor verifies a worker push on pass, so I can audit which commits actually reached origin without re-deriving it from git reflog.
acceptanceCriteria: src/supervisor/events.ts: WorkerEventKind gains the literal 'pushed' (added to the union alongside 'worker-start' | 'worker-end' | 'result' | 'tokens' | 'stale-lock' | 'rate-limited').
src/supervisor/events.ts: a PushEventDetail interface is exported with shape { sha: string; pushed: boolean; ok: boolean; detail: string }; WorkerEventDetail union includes PushEventDetail.

Rationale for choosing a new 'pushed' kind over attaching to the 'result' event is captured in a code comment near the PushEventDetail definition (single auditable record per push, decoupled lifecycle from the rich per-story 'result' record so a push verification at every pass does not perturb the existing result-event consumer surface).

src/supervisor/loop.ts: after ensurePushed runs on a pass (both exit-mode and sentinel-mode branches), the supervisor calls emit('pushed', storyId, uuid, { sha, pushed, ok, detail }) using the existing emit helper that respects logEvent absence.
When logEvent is absent, no 'pushed' event is emitted (zero behavior change vs. today).
When ensurePushed is absent, no 'pushed' event is emitted (the event corresponds to a real verification, not a phantom one).

test/supervisor/events.test.ts: a unit test asserts the 'pushed' event is appended as a single JSON line by makeFileEventLogger (read back and JSON.parse'd in the test: kind:'pushed' and a PushEventDetail-shaped detail) and is captured by makeInMemoryEventLogger.

test/supervisor/loop.test.ts: extends the US-001 cases so (a) pass-with-ensurePushed-ok produces exactly one 'pushed' event with sha from the adapter, pushed and ok mirrored from the adapter, ordered AFTER the 'result' event; (b) ensurePushed ok:false case still emits a 'pushed' event with ok:false before the supervisor returns blocked; (c) missing-logger case emits zero events (no crash); (d) ensurePushed absent case emits zero 'pushed' events.
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck)
Tests pass (bun test)
userStories.notes: Depends on US-001 (needs ensurePushed already wired). Files to touch: src/supervisor/events.ts (extend WorkerEventKind union + add PushEventDetail to the WorkerEventDetail union with explanatory comment), src/supervisor/loop.ts (call emit('pushed', ...) after ensurePushed in both pass-branch sites), test/supervisor/events.test.ts (round-trip test for the new kind), test/supervisor/loop.test.ts (extend US-001 cases). Use the existing emit() helper inside runSupervisor (around line 392-400) which already guards on logEvent presence: do not introduce a parallel emitter. Event ordering: emit the 'result' event first (already happens for pass), then writeSessionMarker, then ensurePushed, then emit('pushed', ...). Use the ACTUAL completed story id (outcome.storyId for exit mode, sentinelOutcome.storyId for sentinel mode), not advisoryStoryId. Gotchas: WorkerEventDetail is currently `ResultEventDetail | TokensEventDetail | Record<string, unknown>` so adding PushEventDetail as a named member is type-safe but the Record<string, unknown> already accepts the shape; still add the named alias for documentation/grep. noUncheckedIndexedAccess applies. Conventional commit; if a new event kind shows up in CHANGELOG/README anywhere, update there too per Doc Maintenance principle.
